_meta.contract: PURPOSE_CONFIRMATION_V5 host/card absolute-validator parity contract vectors
_meta.singleSourceOfTruth: This file is loaded by BOTH the Go mount-gate test (ValidateConfirmationCardEntryProjection / ValidateConfirmationOptionsProjection) and the Card JavaScript test (real validateIntent / validateSubmission / validateOptions / decode). There must never be a second hand-written expectation table.

fieldSemantics.kind: INTENT_ENTRY | OPTIONS | SUBMISSION — which Card entrypoint the vector drives.
fieldSemantics.scope: MOUNT_ABSOLUTE = decidable from a single canonical confirmation_show / confirmation_options_get envelope; BOUND_ENTRY_RELATIVE = only comparable after the Card already holds a prior entry/pendingCommit, so the single-read Go mount gate must NOT claim coverage of it.
fieldSemantics.fixture: name under fixtures/* the mutation applies to
fieldSemantics.mutation: ordered list of ops applied to the fixture before validation
fieldSemantics.ops: set {path,value} | delete {path} | push {path,value} | pushAt {path,value} (alias of push). path is '.'-joined object keys with optional [i] array index relative to the fixture root.
fieldSemantics.expectedAccepted: true = the Card first-binds the entry (entryBound) / accepts options; false = the Card throws
fieldSemantics.expectedDisposition: the Card fail(...) stage for a rejection (asserted on the JS side; the Go side normalizes stage to RECEIPT_READBACK and only asserts expectedReasonCode parity)
fieldSemantics.expectedReasonCode: the Card fail(...) code — the machine reason code. Both runtimes must agree on this for MOUNT_ABSOLUTE vectors.

_meta.parityBoundary: MOUNT_ABSOLUTE is enforced identically by the Go mount gate and the Card. BOUND_ENTRY_RELATIVE is enforced only by the Card against a previously bound entry/pendingCommit; the Go test asserts these are NOT single-read decidable and documents the boundary rather than faking coverage.

retryDispositionContract.producer: Core's NormalizePublicIntent derives submission.retryDisposition from the durable receipt. No public surface accepts it as input, and the Card never infers it from transport failure, timeout, a missing button or a refresh.

values.NONE: no user retry route: a consumed choice, or a recorded rejection that carries no editable next action
values.EDIT_SELECTION_AND_RESUBMIT: recorded REJECTED_NOT_CONSUMED, consumed=false, nextAction=EDIT_SELECTION on a still-PENDING intent with no frozen commit and expiresAt in the future — the only value that re-arms the Card confirmation control
values.REPREPARE_REQUIRED: the old selection cannot be resubmitted on this intent (stale action, terminal or superseded state); a new prepare is the only route
values.READ_ORIGINAL_RECEIPT: the request was not observed or its outcome is unknown; only a receipt readback is permitted

retryDispositionContract.invariants: EDIT_SELECTION_AND_RESUBMIT requires recorded=true, outcome=REJECTED_NOT_CONSUMED, businessOutcome=REJECTED_NOT_CONSUMED, consumptionDisposition=NOT_CONSUMED, consumed=false, nextAction=EDIT_SELECTION, state=PENDING, intent.commit absent and expiresAt in the future. An expired, terminal or committed intent re-derives to REPREPARE_REQUIRED. A consumed submission requires NONE. An unrecorded submission requires READ_ORIGINAL_RECEIPT. Any other pairing is RETRY_DISPOSITION_CONFLICT.

variants.label: Retry review
variants.summary: Re-run the review with the requested changes.

failure.message: The confirmation preflight rejected this selection before any business step ran.
